<h2 style="text-align: center;">WELCOME TO GERALDTON WESTERN AUSTRALIA​</h2>
<h2 style="text-align: center;">KITESURFING CAMP, WAVE RIDING/FREESTYLE CLINICS AND DOWNWINDERS IN THE WINDIEST SPOT OF WA​</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">From September to April, Coronation Beach Western Australia, offers top quality Wind and Waves conditions welcoming windsurfers and Kite surfers from the 4 corners of the world.​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Warm water, hot weather, consistent strong wind and quality swells make this place a MUST Travel kite destination. ​</p>
</div> </div> </div></div></div></section><section class="l-section wpb_row height_full valign_center width_full color_alternate with_img parallax_fixed with_overlay"><div class="l-section-img perfmatters-lazy" style data-img-width="1200" data-img-height="800" data-bg="https://kitewest.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/AM5_4349-scaled.jpg" ></div><div class="l-section-overlay" style="background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.01)"></div><div class="l-section-h i-cf"><div class="g-cols offset_small"><div class=" full-width"><div class="g-cols wpb_row offset_small vc_inner "><div class=" one-sixth"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 1px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div><div class=" two-thirds"><div class="wpb_text_column  font-big txt-shadow txt-bg-img"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h2 style="text-align: center;">“All included” Kitesurfing holidays​<br />
For intermediate and advanced riders​</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">KiteWest Water Sports and Shark Bay Kitesurfing have linked up and invite you to join one of our Kitesurfing Camp in Geraldton – Coronation Beach.​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">7 days of Wave riding, Freeride, Freestyle Clinics and Downwinders.​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">2027 Calendar TBA</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">

<h2 style="text-align: center;">Meet us at Coronation Beach Western Australia for an unforgettable Kitesurfing and Camping adventure!​</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">Daily wave riding clinics, downwinders, up-skill courses, and progression lessons​</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">Kitesurfing downwinders and Freestyle​</h3>

<h3>Sunset on the Indian Ocean ​</h3>
<p>Located 15min drive from Coronation Beach, our camp with ocean views welcome a maximum of 10 travellers, offering double, shared or single yurt tent accommodation to suits all budgets. Camp in comfort on a private property enjoying unique sunsets and dinners in nature.​</p>

<h3 style="text-align: center;">How to get to Geraldton Western Australia?​</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">Fly to Perth International or Domestic airport &#8211; Western Australia</p>
</div> </div> <div class="g-cols wpb_row offset_small vc_inner  vc_custom_1663350661563"><div class=" one-third"><div class="wpb_text_column  font-big"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h3 class="h3-img" style="text-align: center;"><img width="50" height="50" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=&#039;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#039;%20width=&#039;50&#039;%20height=&#039;50&#039;%20viewBox=&#039;0%200%2050%2050&#039;%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Icon Plane" class="perfmatters-lazy" data-src="https://kitewest.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/icons8-plane-50-1.png" /> Fly to Geraldton</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">From Perth (PER) Domestic​<br />
To ​<br />
Geraldton (GET)​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">1 hours ​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">​Free Airport pick up​</p>
</div> </div> </div><div class=" one-third  vc_custom_1663314646447"><div class="wpb_text_column  font-big"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h3 class="h3-img" style="text-align: center;"><img width="64" height="64" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=&#039;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#039;%20width=&#039;64&#039;%20height=&#039;64&#039;%20viewBox=&#039;0%200%2064%2064&#039;%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Icon car" class="perfmatters-lazy" data-src="https://kitewest.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/front-car.png" />Drive to Geraldton</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">From Perth​<br />
To ​<br />
Geraldton​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">5 hours or 440 kms​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">No 4WD required</p>
</div> </div> </div><div class=" one-third"><div class="wpb_text_column  font-big"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h3 class="h3-img" style="text-align: center;"><img width="50" height="50" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=&#039;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#039;%20width=&#039;50&#039;%20height=&#039;50&#039;%20viewBox=&#039;0%200%2050%2050&#039;%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Icon bus" class="perfmatters-lazy" data-src="https://kitewest.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/icons8-bus-50.png" />Bus to Geraldton</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">From East Perth Terminal​<br />
To ​<br />
Geraldton ​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">​6 hours​</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Free town pick up​</p>

<h3>Not yet into Kitesurfing? Not a problem ​</h3>
<p>Our tours welcome individual, families and any confident riders as of 12 years old. ​If you are just starting, willing to learn or up-skill your style, our dedicated team of instructors will tailor a beginner or improver kitesurfing course for you. By the end of the week, your first downwinder will be such a reward!​​</p>
<h3>Not travelling with your kite gear or don’t have equipment yet? Not a problem ​</h3>
<p>If you prefer to travel light or are new to the sport, we offer top of the range kiteboarding equipment rental. Brand new or secondhand equipment purchase is also an option. ​Just contact us and we will discuss/organise it for you.​</div> </div> <div class="w-gallery layout_default cols_3 link_media"><div
